'''Tomb of Vaius Antinus''' was the resting place of [[Vaius Antinus]], a Sith record-keeper who lived circa [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. Following his [[Death/Legends|passing]], Antinus was buried on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], a fact that was well known to later [[Archaeology/Legends|archeologists]]. In [[3642 BBY]] the tomb was visited by archaeologist [[Auselio Gann]] and later by his protege [[Talos Drellik]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tomb of Vaius Antinus is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during Talos Drellik companion storyline.
